_comment: ZAP alerts the CI gate does not fail on, each with the reason. Only alerts about the test server, WordPress or WooCommerce belong here, never one about a request our plugin handles. With "params", only instances on those parameters are accepted; the same alert on any other parameter still fails.

accepted.reason: About wp-env's PHP build (read from X-Powered-By), not our code. Stores run the PHP their host provides; we support 8.2 and later.

WooCommerce's My account page and its forms; our plugin handles none of them. password and rememberme (login form) go to wp_signon(): the password is only compared with a hash and rememberme is only checked for being set. user_login (Lost password form, ?lost-password) goes to retrieve_password(), which looks the user up with get_user_by() through prepared queries. amp;embed is not a real parameter: ZAP read the oEmbed link's '&embed=true' literally, and WordPress ignores unknown query vars. ZAP's boolean test only sees the responses differ: a new nonce on every page and different error messages.
